The augmentation of every seven-vertex unlabeled graph by every one of 2^7 neighborhoods contains every eight-vertex graph after deleting a vertex; exact isomorphism and independent standard class count give 12,346 classes. Applying German Corollary 4 is valid for the infinite one-prime-bag family of size<=8. Finite experiments are not the infinite proof; Corollary 4 is the theoretical bridge.
